name: vllm_awq_gemm
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_awq_gemm.py. AWQ 4-bit quantized GEMM: input (M,K) fp16, qweight (K, N//8) int32 packing 8 int4 per int32, scales (K//group_size, N) fp16, qzeros (K//group_size, N//8) int32, split_k_iters int. Reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.awq_gemm and returns the (M,N) result. Shapes are interdependent so inputs are built by gen_inputs from the shapes declared in each workload line. No torch-native fallback exists for AWQ dequant-GEMM; requires vLLM at eval time.
